nativeOccurrenceEnvironment.x-sensitive-key-policy: Only the six enumerated, non-secret Android QA metadata fields are accepted; arbitrary Unity state, credentials, player coordinates, and free-form keys are forbidden.

nativeAuditPayload.x-sensitive-key-policy: Only the enumerated server-built audit projection fields are exposed; raw request bodies, secrets, local paths, attachment bytes, and arbitrary nested event payloads are forbidden.

expiresAt.description: Reservation TTL while status is reserved; null after an atomic claim.

skewMs.description: Absolute start-time skew from captureBundle.capturedAt (the user capture event); artifacts are not claimed to be same-frame atomic and a recording has its own startedAt/endedAt duration.

status.description: Server-derived from negotiatedMethods and succeededMethods; the client cannot promote it.

deadlineMs.description: Relative remaining time budget in monotonic milliseconds at the moment the Unity listener receives the request.

pocoSnapshotData.description: All project fields are optional and progressively adoptable. The containing response correlation envelope remains required.

recentErrors.description: Redacted recent errors only. The combined UTF-8 bytes of all entries must not exceed 32768.

customFields.x-sensitive-key-policy: case-insensitive denylist: password, passwd, secret, token, authorization, cookie, credential, email, phone, session

expectedVersion.description: null only for first registration; token rotation must carry the current device binding version.
